projects.title: Bearly Sleeping
projects.description: Bearly Sleeping is a fast paced, third person hack and slash where the player takes the role of Teddy. Teddy is a stuffed bear trying to protect his best friend Emma from hordes of nightmarish creatures while she sleeps. Players try to defend Emma against 4 waves of ever increasing counts of enemies while using fast sword combat, air juggling, magical sigils and unique buffs to help throughout the night.
